name: jet-router
description: Experimental Claude Code effort router: fake and opt-in Jev shadow

fakeChoice.title: Offline fixture recommendation
fakeChoice.description: Testing only: keep, low, medium, high, or xhigh. No model is called.

provider.title: Classifier
provider.description: fake is offline. Jev requires explicit cloud consent and an API key.

defaultMode.title: Mode at session start
defaultMode.description: off (default), shadow or enforce. With Jev, shadow and enforce send each session's prompts after cloud consent; enforce also changes effort for the turn and its subagents.

usageLog.title: Record local token usage
usageLog.description: Append one line per routed turn (effort decision and token counts, never prompt text) to ~/.claude/jet-router/usage for savings reports.

holdoutRate.title: Enforce control share
holdoutRate.description: Share of applicable enforce turns left unchanged at random so savings can be measured on real work: 0, 0.05, 0.1 or 0.2.

cloudConsent.title: Allow Jev cloud requests
cloudConsent.description: Send each eligible current prompt and effort to api.typesafe.ai in shadow. No files/history. Charges may apply; off cannot undo an already sent request. Review TypeSafe data policy before enabling.

sendTaskContext.title: Send previous turn to Jev
sendTaskContext.description: With Jev cloud consent, also send the previous main turn as taskContext: the prompt's start and the assistant answer's end, 2,000 characters at most. The answer may contain code, paths or values from your session. Off sends the current prompt only.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: Optional for fake. Stored by Claude in secure storage; passed to the Jev helper through stdin, never argv.
